[[File:YodaLukesBackpack-TESB.png|thumb|right|250px|Yoda sits beside Luke's backpack.]]
'''Luke's Backpack''' was a blue colored [[Backpack/Legends|satchel]] made on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] out of [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]]-skin that belonged to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. It possessed many pockets, which Skywalker used while on patrol to hold supplies.<ref name="Dagobah Limited">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Luke's Backpack}}</ref> Skywalker wore it on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], when he was under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] tutelage. Yoda rode inside the backpack at least once, instructing Luke during a training run.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
